testcases.name: pixart-sigma-1024-l0
testcases.description: PixArt-Sigma XL-2 L0 representative at 512px with full cache and step count
testcases.test_prompt: A photo of a cat sitting on a windowsill at sunset
testcases.notes: PR L0 repro for PixArt-Sigma. Uses the same checkpoint, PixArt model type, T5-XXL text encoder, DiT/VAE path, runner, comparator, full 256-token cache shape, 20-step denoising loop, and FP32 T5 selector as the full manifest. L0 uses 512px to reduce DiT/VAE spatial scale; nightly keeps 1024px coverage.
